paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.
model_annotation: The bar chart titled “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B Generation Length Comparison” visually compares the generation length in words for two methods—Vanilla CoT (represented by light pink bars) and TLDR (Ours, represented by dark red bars)—across four benchmark datasets: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC. The horizontal axis lists these datasets in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis, labeled “Generation Length (words),” is scaled linearly from 0 to 8000 with evenly spaced tick marks at intervals of 1000. Each pair of bars corresponds to one dataset, with the Vanilla CoT bar appearing to the left and the TLDR bar to the right within each group. The Vanilla CoT bar for GSM8K is labeled with a value of 679 and a percentage change of -65%, while the TLDR bar for the same dataset is labeled with a value of 2951 and a percentage change of -31%. For AIME, the Vanilla CoT bar reaches a value of 6701 with a -4% change, and the TLDR bar reaches 4584 with a -16% change. The bars are not sorted by height, and no additional visual highlighting or annotations beyond the percentage labels are present.

model_annotations.English: This bar chart, titled “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B Generation Length Comparison,” visually compares the generation length in words for two methods—Vanilla CoT (represented by light pink bars) and TLDR (Ours, represented by dark red bars)—across four benchmark datasets: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC. The vertical axis, labeled “Generation Length (words),” is scaled linearly from 0 to 8000, with tick marks at intervals of 1000, and the horizontal axis lists the four datasets in left-to-right order. Each dataset has two adjacent bars: the Vanilla CoT bar is consistently taller than the TLDR bar, indicating a shorter generation length for TLDR. Specific values are labeled on top of each bar: for GSM8K, Vanilla CoT generates 679 words while TLDR generates 112 words (a -65% reduction); for MATH500, Vanilla CoT generates 2951 words while TLDR generates 1845 words (a -31% reduction); for AIME, Vanilla CoT generates 6701 words while TLDR generates 6417 words (a -4% reduction); and for AMC, Vanilla CoT generates 4584 words while TLDR generates 3850 words (a -16% reduction). The chart does not show any sorting of bars by height, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and numerical annotations.
